quotes.speaker: Kyle Kuzma
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Kuzma on the benefits of the new practice system
quotes.excerpt: It's constructive learning and giving us avenues to be creative within a limited space.
quotes.quote: It's constructive learning and giving us avenues to be creative within a limited space. I think it's been good. I think it's definitely a challenge, an obstacle because it's new, not super familiar to a lot of us, which is fine, but we've been making a lot of growth. You only have four or five practices of that and then you go into games and you try to put it all together and you just throw it out there. Especially with preseason, you figure it out on the fly and do the best you can.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Kuzma says the team is still adjusting to a new practice system, noting that while it is a challenge, they are making growth as they try to put it all together on the fly during the preseason.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Kuzma
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Kuzma on the team's open-minded approach to coaching
quotes.excerpt: It's fun to push your brain and do things that are different.
quotes.quote: It's fun to push your brain and do things that are different. I feel like we have a pretty open-minded team. The transition of doing these things has been very open and very receiving. We trust everything that the coaching staff is doing and how they're trying to teach and implement things. It's a long process. For us to be where we are right now, we're going to look totally different in two weeks and totally different by mid-December.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Kuzma praises the team for being open-minded to the coaching staff's new approach, adding that the group will look totally different in two weeks and even more so by mid-December.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Kuzma
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Kuzma on the team's need for better movement
quotes.excerpt: We want to have high standards, so we had a lot of possessions where we didn't move.
quotes.quote: We want to have high standards, so we had a lot of possessions where we didn't move or we might have moved and we missed the guy. It's all about building those right habits. We came out today and I felt like our movement on middle ball drives or baseline drives was much quicker, faster, and wider. I feel like we got a lot more open threes. It's something that we just need to continue to feel and then implement in the game because that's what really matters.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Kuzma says the team is focused on building better habits, specifically noting that their movement on ball drives was much quicker and wider today, which led to more open threes.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Kuzma
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Kuzma on the upcoming test against the Oklahoma City Thunder
quotes.excerpt: I can imagine this type of style is going to be pretty good for us in OKC.
quotes.quote: I can imagine this type of style is going to be pretty good for us in OKC because OKC is a team that historically wants to pack the paint and make you make those type of passes. It'll be a good test for us just to visually see it in a game versus a defensive culture.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Kuzma expects the upcoming game against OKC to be a good test for their new offensive style, noting that the Thunder historically pack the paint and force teams to make difficult passes.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Kuzma
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Kuzma on his role as a coachable leader
quotes.excerpt: I've always been somebody that's been super coachable, whatever anybody's ever asked me from any level.
quotes.quote: I've always been somebody that's been super coachable, whatever anybody's ever asked me from any level, I've always done. Being able to lead that way, I feel great. I'm happy to play basketball, blessed to be able to play basketball. Doing a new style is okay, it's nothing. It's just learning, and it adds to your basketball knowledge of the game. It's going to bode well because as we get it and everybody sees certain things, it's going to be really good for my playstyle.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Kuzma says he is happy to be coachable and learn a new style, noting that adding to his basketball knowledge will ultimately bode well for his own playstyle.
